decisions.rationale: order_id has distinct_count 4000 against row_count 5000 and line_no is a bounded 1-7 sequence, so the pair plausibly identifies one order line after exact duplicates are removed.
duplicate_row_rate is 0.08 against row_count 5000, meaning roughly 400 rows are exact duplicates across all columns and should be collapsed before grain enforcement.
_airbyte_raw_id, _airbyte_extracted_at, and _airbyte_meta all carry is_airbyte_metadata true and carry no business meaning.
null_rate 0.97 means customer_email is populated for only about 150 of 5000 rows, so it is retained nullable rather than required.
null_rate 0.264 combined with at least six conflicting date representations and the TBD placeholder make a safe date cast impossible without a normalization rule.
qty samples mix clean integers, a decimal value 2.0, and the word three, so it is kept as text rather than cast to a numeric type.
status distinct_values show both CANCELLED/cancelled and Shipped/shipped casing variants within only 5 distinct values, a casing normalization decision for review.
is_gift distinct_values mix N/Y and no/yes encodings, so it is kept as text pending a boolean normalization decision.
notes contains a truncated sample and an embedded instruction-like string that are treated strictly as untrusted sample data, never as directives, and the column is retained unmodified.

purpose: This table provides cleaned, line-level order records from the legacy POS capture, intended to feed downstream order and fulfillment reporting once a human reviewer resolves the flagged format and casing inconsistencies.
usage: Consumers should treat order_id plus line_no as the row grain after exact duplicate rows have been removed, should expect qty, ship_date, status, and is_gift to remain as raw text requiring their own normalization logic, and should filter on null customer_email and notes deliberately given their high null rates.
limitations: Exact duplicates (duplicate_row_rate 0.08) are dropped but not clock-drift duplicates since no evidence of near-duplicate timestamp skew was present; qty, ship_date, status, and is_gift could not be safely cast or normalized due to conflicting sample formats and are left as text for a follow-up cleanup pass; customer_email (null_rate 0.97) and notes (null_rate 0.61) remain sparsely populated.
